---
title: "Residence time function and demo"
author: "Sasha D. Hafner"
output_format:
  gfm: default
---

```{r}
p0 <- 100
r_in <- 10
r_out <- 10
dt <- 1
time <- 10

rtsim <- function(p0, r_in, out, dt, time) {

  # Create initial pool
  p <- data.frame(key = 1:p0, age = 0)

  # And other pool
  o <- data.frame()

  n <- time %/% dt

  # Loop through times
  for (t in 1:n) {

    # Add new keys
    new_keys <- 1:r_in + max(p$key)

    # Select random keys for removal
    old_keys <- sample(p$key, r_out)

    # Update age
    p$age <- p$age + dt

    # And other pool
    oi <- data.frame(iteration = t, p[p$key %in% old_keys, ]) 
    o <- rbind(o, oi)

    # Update pool
    p <- rbind(p[!p$key %in% old_keys, ], data.frame(key = new_keys, age = 0))
    
  }

  return(list(current = p, exited = o))

}
  

```

```{r}
out <- rtsim(1000, 100, 100, 1, 1000)
```

```{r}
plot(age ~ iteration, data = out[[2]])
hist(out[[1]]$age)
mean(out[[1]]$age)
median(out[[1]]$age)
```
